fields.statement: At 8c0b44ac, go test -trimpath -count=1 -v ./internal/ciworkflow/... passed all 5 tests: the existing triggers, checkout/run-name and concurrency checks plus new TestCIJobsAndMatrices and TestCICheckAggregatesEveryJob. Reading ci.yml and the diff: jobs lint, scripts (matrix shard [1/4..4/4]), api (matrix [1/2, 2/2]), rest, budgets, each with fail-fast false on its matrix, actions/setup-go with cache: true and cache-dependency-path: go.sum, and a run step calling make lint / make test-scripts SHARD / make test-api SHARD / make test-rest / make test-budgets (all exist in the Makefile; make -n test-scripts SHARD=1/4 and test-rest expand as expected); check needs all five, if: always(), and exits 1 unless every needs.*.result is success. PyYAML parses the file to those six jobs. The PR CI duration (about 5 minutes via gh run view) is not observable here: no PR exists for the change set yet, so that point is left to the ship run's CI.
